label: Technical QA passes; production approval is blocked
environment: Windows local QA with Node 22.23.1, npm 10.9.8 and Chromium desktop/mobile

blockers.summary: The complete Romanian interface and content set is not approved or implemented.
acceptanceCriteria: Approve Romanian UI, product content, editorial content, metadata and alt text.
Publish shareable /ro/... routes with reciprocal hreflang.
Pass Russian and Romanian smoke, accessibility and SEO checks.

blockers.summary: Telegram delivery works locally, but privacy, production origin and abuse protection are not approved.
acceptanceCriteria: Approve the Moldova legal recipient, consent copy and retention policy.
Configure the production origin and server-side WAF or rate limiting.
Verify successful and failed submissions on the deployed form without duplicate delivery.

blockers.summary: Moldova legal review has not approved any regulated product claim.
acceptanceCriteria: Assign a qualified Moldova reviewer.
Record classification, evidence, reviewer, date and document reference for each claim.
Keep pending and rejected claims out of production output.

blockers.summary: The final production assortment and the disposition of three draft products are not approved.
acceptanceCriteria: Approve the final list of products for Moldova.
Complete and approve each retained draft or remove it from the source dataset.
Pass the content completeness gate with the approved assortment.

blockers.summary: Production publication rights for product, brand and editorial media are not confirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: Record the source and permitted production use for each published asset.
Remove or replace any asset without confirmed rights.

blockers.summary: Moldova certificates and the final local scope for service and editorial pages are not approved.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide Moldova-applicable certificate metadata and document sources.
Approve the Moldova scope for FAQ, branches, Blog and News.
Keep foreign certificates clearly separated from Moldova evidence.

blockers.summary: The popularity ranking has no approved business data source.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide an approved popularity rank or approve official catalogue order as the permanent fallback.
Document and test the selected comparator.

blockers.summary: The repository workflow exists, but the required GitHub branch rule is not verified.
acceptanceCriteria: Push the workflow to GitHub.
Require the quality-gates check on the main branch.
Verify that a failing check blocks merge.

blockers.summary: The production origin and live search-engine validation are not approved.
acceptanceCriteria: Approve the public production origin and build with SITE_URL.
Deploy prerendered canonical routes, sitemap and robots policy.
Pass live Rich Results and URL inspection without critical errors.
